title: Hue in a day
summary: Sleep on the south bank. Cross for the Imperial City when the gate opens, eat bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and at dusk walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh.

stops.name: Hue Citadel
stops.note: Go when the gate opens, 06:30 from 16 March to 15 October and 07:00 from 16 October to 15 March, on the 200,000 VND adult ticket that does not cover the tombs.

approach.note: From the south bank, cross to the north-bank gate.

stops.name: Bun bo Hue
stops.note: Eat bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, then bánh khoái and bánh bèo.

stops.name: Perfume River walk
stops.note: At dusk, walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh.

seoTitle: Hue in a day — citadel opening and the river at dusk
seoDescription: One day in Hue: the Imperial City when the gate opens, bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and the river walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh at dusk.
